title: feat(console): Allowed IP ranges shows the address the server judges before a save
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2w1nngmTV9xFM22hjNeNh5)_

domain:ui#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVFhcnGrB1Wp8fLTwB

Fixes #30313

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置页「认证」里的「允许的 IP 段」字段下方，新增一行说明服务器判定的当前地址（读 `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/client-address`），并按 `trustProxy` 说明这个地址是取自受信任代理的转发头，还是连接本身（不信任代理时，在代理之后看到的是代理地址）；服务器无法确定地址时，说明此处无法保存非空列表。保存被拒时这行仍在，与拒绝信息并列。
- 为什么改：保存一个不含自己地址的列表会被拒绝，但以前管理员只有先被拒一次，才知道服务器认的是哪个地址。
- 风险与回滚：只加不改，只读一个已落地的接口；接口拒绝（非平台管理员 401/403）、老服务器没有该接口或网络失败时，什么都不显示，页面其余不变。新增 3 个文案键，10 种语言都已翻译。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsView.tsx`（读取与 `clientAddressNote`）；`SettingsField.tsx` 新的 `note` 槽与 `aria-describedby`；`api.ts` 的 `getJudgedClientAddress` 形状检查。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.clientAddress-30313.test.tsx`，预期 1 个文件、9 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Item 1 of the card. The Authentication settings page reads the caller's address as the server judges it, `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/client-address` (PR #30483: `{ clientAddress, trustProxy }` from the save check's own `judgedClientAddress` call, platform-admin gated, `no-store`), and draws one line under the Allowed IP ranges row:

- `trustProxy: false`: "Your address, as the server judges it: ADDRESS. A list that leaves it out cannot be saved from here. This server does not trust proxy headers, so behind a proxy this is the proxy's address."
- `trustProxy: true`: the address, "read from the forwarded headers of the proxy this server trusts".
- `clientAddress: null`: "The server cannot establish your address, so a non-empty list cannot be saved from here." (the route's documented consequence of null).

The trustProxy half is spelled out because it changes what the admin should do with the address: with trust off, behind a proxy every caller is judged by the proxy's address.

- `api.ts`: `getJudgedClientAddress()`, through the module's existing envelope unwrap; a body whose `clientAddress` is not a non-empty string or null, or whose `trustProxy` is not a boolean, throws by name.
- `SettingsView.tsx`: reads it once per visit, only on the `auth` namespace, and passes the sentence as `note` to the `allowed_ip_ranges` row. Any failure (401, 403, a server without the route, a malformed body, a network error) draws no note: no guessed address, and the page is otherwise unchanged.
- `SettingsField.tsx`: an optional `note` drawn under the control after the help text or the error, never in place of either; the control's `aria-describedby` names the error and the note.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `console.settingsView.clientAddressDirect`, `clientAddressViaProxy`, `clientAddressUnknown` in all ten shipped packs (en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar).

Item 2 re-measured, not rebuilt: on this branch a refused save still shows the server's sentence naming `constraint.clientAddress` in red under the row (the generic field-error path), and the new line stays beside it. Both items hold, so `Fixes #30313`.

Before / after, real stack (showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, the branch's console under vite, Playwright 1440 px; "before" is the same page with the note's one line ablated live, held and restored with `ablation-replace.mjs`):

| | zh-CN |
|:--|:--|
| before, nothing under the field says which address is judged | ![before](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1c74c2245caa2590e453e24fa209a549b965f6c/evidence/30313/before-1-before-save-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true) |
| after, the judged address under the field | ![after](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1c74c2245caa2590e453e24fa209a549b965f6c/evidence/30313/after-1-before-save-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true) |
| after, a refused save: the server's sentence, and the line beside it | ![refused](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1c74c2245caa2590e453e24fa209a549b965f6c/evidence/30313/after-2-refused-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true) |

en-US after: ![after en](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1c74c2245caa2590e453e24fa209a549b965f6c/evidence/30313/after-1-before-save-en-US-1440.png?raw=true)

## Tests

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.clientAddress-30313.test.tsx`, the whole page over a stubbed `fetch` and the real `api.ts`, sentences read from the shipped `en` pack: the note under the list and only there, help text kept, `aria-describedby`; the trust-proxy and null sentences; no note on 403, 401, a malformed body and a network failure; no read on another namespace with a same-named key; the note kept beside a `SETTINGS_VALIDATION` refusal carrying `constraint.clientAddress`, both named by `aria-describedby`, one read per visit.

## Acceptance notes

- The note is hard-wired to `auth` / `allowed_ip_ranges` in the console, as the route ledger entry describes ("the console's Authentication settings page reads it beside the Allowed IP ranges field"); the settings manifest has no key to declare it.
- `@object-ui/i18n` gains three keys and no export, so `Clause-②: no` stands.
- The en pack is in the eager closure; three sentences are added to it. The eager-closure budget is measured by CI's Bundle Analysis, not locally.

## Verification

<details><summary>Unit tests (head 7dbb9868, code identical at da21d372)</summary>

`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/settings` (in `ui/`, under `os-verify-lock`): `Test Files 35 passed (35)`, `Tests 297 passed (297)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

`ablation-replace.mjs` on `SettingsView.tsx`, anchor `? clientAddressNote(judgedAddress, t)` to `? undefined` (anchor 1 to 0, blob b5ed73e9 to d292d590): the new file goes `4 failed | 5 passed (9)`, the four presence cases red, the five absence cases green as expected. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Live readings (real stack)</summary>

- `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/client-address` as the seeded admin: 200, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `{ success: true, data: { clientAddress: "127.0.0.1", trustProxy: false } }`.
- Row text before a save (en-US): label, help text, then "Your address, as the server judges it: 127.0.0.1. A list that leaves it out cannot be saved from here. This server does not trust proxy headers, so behind a proxy this is the proxy's address." zh-CN: "服务器判定的你的地址：127.0.0.1。不包含该地址的列表无法在此保存。此服务器不信任代理转发头，若部署在代理之后，这里显示的是代理的地址。"
- Save `203.0.113.0/24`: `PUT /api/settings/auth` 400 `SETTINGS_VALIDATION`, `details.fields[0]` field `allowed_ip_ranges`, code `invalid_value`, `constraint.clientAddress` `127.0.0.1`; the row shows that message in red, then the note; toast "1 setting needs attention: Allowed IP ranges". Same in zh-CN with the server's zh sentence.
- Before (note ablated): the row carries label and help text only, in both locales; the refusal reads the same.
</details>
